question: What is the primary purpose of an asset renewal strategy in a large distribution system?
correctAnswer: To replace or rehabilitate assets before failure risk and service impact become unacceptable
explanation: A renewal strategy uses condition, criticality, and risk to time interventions before failures disrupt service.
options: To replace every asset at the same fixed age regardless of condition
To replace or rehabilitate assets before failure risk and service impact become unacceptable
To defer all renewal until assets fail in service
To focus renewal spending only on the newest parts of the network
optionA: To replace every asset at the same fixed age regardless of condition
optionB: To replace or rehabilitate assets before failure risk and service impact become unacceptable
optionC: To defer all renewal until assets fail in service
optionD: To focus renewal spending only on the newest parts of the network
